reason: Fold the metal into a case to start building the container for the core.
expectation: The jig will form a case body, though it may still need insulation and cooling.

alternatives.reason: Freezing the packs also seems necessary, but I want the case first.

effect: The jig made the expected shell; it can now be insulated.
reaction: A straightforward, satisfying start to the case.
reason: Fit insulation into the shell to slow heat entering the case.
expectation: An insulated case body, still needing refrigeration and cold packs.

alternatives.reason: The packs need chilling too, but I will assemble the case first.

effect: The case is insulated as expected, ready for its cooling insert.
reaction: The assembly is clear, though so far quite routine.
reason: Add the refrigeration insert to make the insulated container actively cold.
expectation: A refrigerated case, perhaps still requiring cold packs before it is ready.

alternatives.reason: Chilling packs is also useful; I want to finish the main assembly first.

effect: The case now has refrigeration; the remaining offered action prepares its packs.
reaction: The result matches what I expected, without additional detail.
reason: Freeze the cold packs for the case; it is the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: The packs will be chilled and become available to fit into the case.

effect: The packs are charged for a limited transfer, and I understand they need active refrigeration to restore their capacity.
reaction: That distinction between absorbing heat and recharging is a useful detail.
reason: Put the conditioned packs in the refrigerated case, the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: A completed cold case with temporary protection during transfer.

effect: The packs complete the buffered case and the chapter's goal; the core itself remains to be collected.
reaction: It is satisfying to finish the case, though I would have liked to see it used on the sample.

mostWorthwhile.text: Conditioning the cold packs explained their limited heat absorption and the need to restore capacity with refrigeration; that made their role in the case more concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting insulation and then the refrigeration insert were predictable assembly steps with little feedback beyond the new names.

surprise.text: The explicit distinction between temporary heat absorption and active recharging sharpened my understanding of the packs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each part had an apparent role, although the menu guided the assembly and I did not learn much about the insert itself.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see whether a whole ridged object can be recovered from the ice; completing the case sets up that question but does not answer it.
